items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: I worked with Charlie Johnson. The same time. I was fired from Charlie Johnson's band

ctx.x: And he said, we'll get a band out there, so we organized a little band in Atlantic City called the Tennessee 10. And we didn't get any work. We starved to death. So I -- someone took me over to the Paradise where Charlie Johnson had his band and I went there on tenor saxophone and I played everything -- was lovely until the show, and when the show came on, I naturally couldn't read so they fired me right away. And then I went -- I was pushing chairs on the Boardwalk, hopping bells at night.
